items: Mix into ice cream freezer and freeze.

notes.title: Variations
items: Crushed candy such as Butterfingers, Heath or Skor bars, Reese's peanut butter cups, etc.

notes.title: Strawberry
items: Use 2 cups sugar instead of 3/4 cup and add 1 quart mashed strawberries.

notes.title: Mint chocolate
items: Omit vanilla and use chocolate pudding instead of vanilla. Add 1 pkg Andes mints (chopped), 1/2 pkg grasshopper cookies (chopped up), and 1 tsp peppermint extract.
